Docket 1.3.137

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *Every kind of local business is recognised in your markup.* Docket recognised a short list of local
  business types, so a gym marked up as a gym was told it had no local business markup at all, and so
  would a winery, a brewery, a car dealer or a bed and breakfast. It now recognises every local business
  type in schema.org's own vocabulary.
- *When a page describes your business twice, the fuller description is the one checked.* A homepage
  with a short and a full description of the same business was told the full one's details were missing.
- *A phone extension is not a vanity number.* A phone link with an extension written as a letter and
  digits was described as a number spelled in letters that dials nothing. It is now described as an
  extension, with the standard way to write one.

99 checks across 13 areas.
